source_anchor: Assumption 3, Corollary 5.4, and the varying-order proof
contract: The premise zeta(n)=1-n^{-q} must imply the tail bound used in the proof before the claimed T^((q+1)/(2q+1)) interpolation follows.

verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: A sequence satisfies literal Assumption 3 for the selected q but violates the asserted tail inequality; an L2-admissible sequence may even have divergent l1 tail.
verdict_rule.VERIFIED: The tail implication and resulting rate hold over the literal quantified premise.
